hero.h2: I Turn Data into Decisions and Chaos into Automation.
hero.p: Data Scientist with a background in Economics and Entrepreneurship. Specialized in creating Viable AI solutions (Green AI), process automation, and business intelligence.
about.p1: My path isn't linear, and that's my greatest advantage. I am a Data Scientist forged in the reality of entrepreneurship and crisis management.
about.p2: Before training Artificial Intelligence models, I learned to manage real-world inefficiency: I founded businesses, pivoted strategies, and managed P&L. This experience taught me that data without economic viability is just noise.
about.p3: Today, I combine an owner's mindset with advanced technical skills (Python, Green AI, Automation) to build solutions that are not just technically robust, but financially sustainable and sovereign.

modal.green.title: Green AI & Digital Sovereignty
modal.green.desc:
We are living through the honeymoon phase of Generative AI, but operational inference costs are being ignored. My current research focuses on the Economic Viability of LLMs. I investigate optimization techniques (such as Quantization and Pruning) to run language models on local infrastructure (Edge Computing), drastically reducing energy consumption and latency.

The goal is strategic: ensure Digital Sovereignty. By moving intelligence to the edge (on-device), we eliminate dependency on unstable foreign APIs and protect sensitive data privacy, proving that AI can be both 'Green' and financially sustainable.
modal.baco.title: The Paradox of Choice (BACO)
modal.baco.desc:
In 2019, I founded BACO with a central thesis: the excess of unstructured data generates anxiety, not decisions (The Paradox of Choice). While the market focused on volume, I designed the architecture of a Hybrid Recommendation System that used psychographic data to 'curate' experiences, acting as a noise filter for the end user.

The project, a finalist in innovation contests, was my Human-in-the-Loop laboratory. I learned in practice how to structure qualitative data pipelines and validate SaaS business models. This experience shaped my current view on AI Agents: technology's function should be to reduce human cognitive load, delivering precision instead of hallucination.
modal.d4r.title: Data-Driven Consulting (D4R)
modal.d4r.desc:
As a co-founder of D4R in Portugal, I acted on the frontlines of digitalizing traditional companies. My mission was to prepare the cultural and technical ground for technology. I implemented Business Intelligence routines and process automations that allowed managers to make decisions based on evidence (P&L and Cash Flow), rather than just intuition.

This case proves my ability to translate 'tech speak' into business results. By structuring data governance and optimizing inefficient operations, I created the necessary foundations for these businesses to scale, demonstrating that real digital transformation starts in strategy and processes, long before it reaches software.
